summary: A 1931 pole tower with an L-4 cab on Coeur d'Alene National Forest land, destroyed in 1955; the Idaho site authors found no remains, only a clearing.

facts.design: 30-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab, plus two patrol points
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1955; the Idaho site found no remains on the ridge, only a clearing

events.note: 30-foot pole L-4 tower atop the easternmost point, with patrol points 1/4 mile west and 1.5 miles southwest
Destroyed; the sources do not name a cause

evidence.supports: built 1931 as a 30-foot pole L-4 tower atop easternmost point; patrol points; destroyed 1955
evidence.quote: 1931: 30' pole L-4 tower atop easternmost point. Patrol points 1/4 mile west and 1.5 miles southwest. Destroyed 1955.

evidence.supports: built 1931 atop the easternmost point; patrol lookout 1/4 mile west and 1 1/2 miles southwest
evidence.quote: 1931: 30′ Pole L-4 built atop the easternmost point. Also a patrol lookout 1/4 mile west and 1 1/2 miles southwest.

evidence.supports: searched the ridge and found nothing left of the towers
evidence.quote: We scoured this mountain ridge for anything left of these towers but didn’t find a single thing.

evidence.supports: the best find was a clearing suited to a tower
evidence.quote: The best we could come up with was a clearing that looked like a great spot for a tower.

sources.title: Cathedral Peak Lookout – Idaho Fire Lookouts
Idaho Lookouts – Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Unresolved location conflict: the record uses the FFLA list point (47.9521, -116.10983); the record's idaho_fl source gives 47.9441, -116.1418. Elevation disputed (4,090 ft on firelookout.com, 4,291 ft on the Idaho site); the story gives both. The 'cement footings remain' line on the Idaho Coeur d'Alene category page belongs to Divide Peak, not Cathedral, so it is not used. No staffing, access or new photos found.
